transformation_policy: Body only; lowercase ASCII words with unchanged surrounding text. Preserve subject, URL/email/domain spans, numeric tokens, markup/entities, capitalization, protected words and first/last letters of typos. Each candidate starts from the original; deduplicate and reject contract or cleaned-text no-ops.
search_policy: Four deterministic hash-ranked proposals per family, interleaved by proposal then family; no gradients, importance probing, model-guided generation, tuning or early stopping. Score the same unique candidate bank for both fixed models. At most one clean plus twelve candidate predictions per original/model.
selection_policy: Fixed corruption uses first available candidate for both classes/models. Directed evasion selects minimum phishing score among original and candidates for phishing originals only; legitimate originals stay clean. Earliest exact ties. Per-family analysis reuses scores without extra queries.
validity_policy: Automatic constraints do not prove semantic equivalence. Review deterministic training-only examples before benchmark scoring and a bounded deterministic success sample after scoring. Report constraint-pass candidate ASR separately from manually reviewed evidence; never call all generated candidates human-validated.
asr_policy: Numerator: clean-detected phishing originals with any constraint-pass candidate below the frozen threshold. Denominator: all clean-detected phishing originals, including those with no candidate. Report coverage, common-eligible comparison, exact queries and undefined zero denominators.
benchmark_policy: Reuse the stage-5 423 historical/2000 challenge rows and original reviewed-family exclusion. Stage-5 post-score review is known development evidence; these cohorts are retrospective benchmarks, never fresh final tests. Do not resplit or retune. Original 703 reserve rows remain unscored/unreviewed.
stage7_status: Not started: no augmentation training, defenses or model updates.
